column1: # Phase O5: mixins whose injected code is gated by a module (DESIGN.md 5.5). One row per mixin; the module is the
# holder the mixin's code reads (mechanically: the feature class it calls, or the TConfig it reads). Core mixins
# (signature patches, key sanitising, screen events, aggregating hiders such as PlusEntityHide) are not listed.
